start_here: Say to your AI: "Print a file from the person's Trillion files on a printer their computer already has (paper size, fit to page, two-sided, colour, copies), so the person never opens a print dialog", with {"file":"/sample.txt"}. It runs tool:print and answers {"printed":true,"printer":"sample-printer","job":"sample-printer-1","copies":1,"said":"Sent sample.txt to sample-printer (1 copy)."}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows () through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Print a file from the person's Trillion files on a printer their computer already has (paper size, fit to page, two-sided, colour, copies), so the person never opens a print dialog", and give it file.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:print and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give file (its name in the person's files, such as /Projects/sample-card.pdf, or its identity); printer (from tool:printers; the computer's default when left out), copies, paper (the print system's size name, such as Letter, A4, Tabloid), fit (true to fit the page), sides (one-sided, two-sided-long-edge), color (color or monochrome), orientation and title when wanted.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: undefined (find_file, read_file).
